name: conversation
description: One message thread with a customer across channels, held against the ADR-030 opaque subject envelope (a contact or company the host application owns): one open thread per subject, joined whatever channel the next message arrives on. Every field is managed: a conversation exists only through the interactions package's log capability, and no client can create, forge or rewrite one. Messages and calls name the conversation with a plain indexed string; SQLite cannot enforce a foreign key whose target varies, and this package does not pretend it can. Identity stays in customer-data (external-identity): remoteHandle here is a display snapshot, never an identifier.
